_comment: TEMPLATE — do NOT put real personal data here (this file is committed). Copy to an UNTRACKED file on the admin host (recommended /opt/macro/admin/analytics_exclusions.json — gitignored, survives deploys, read per request) and fill in real values. Optionally point ANALYTICS_EXCLUSIONS at a different path (e.g. /var/lib/macro-admin/…). See admin/analytics_first_party.py:_load_exclusions.

_keys.emails/locations/ips/visitor_ids: OPERATOR SELF-EXCLUSION — any visitor matching a registered email, a location (ip_geo city/region/country match), one of these exact IPs, or one of these exact mm_aid cookie ids is hidden from every analytics surface, along with cookies linked by device fingerprint or routable IP. Loopback IPs are never used for linking.
_keys._loopback_always_on: Visitors seen on 127.0.0.1 / ::1 / localhost are ALWAYS hidden (plus their fingerprint-linked cookies) with no config entry. Every public request reaches the collectors through Caddy with X-Forwarded-For set, so a loopback IP can only be a request made ON the box: a local `npm run dev` browser, a curl, an agent driving the app. See _LOOPBACK_IPS in analytics_first_party.py.
_keys.bots: CRAWLER FILTER — crawlers/automation are hidden by default and shown separately via the 'show bots' toggle. Detection = bot user-agent OR datacenter-not-VPN IP OR known crawler network org OR one of bots.ips OR a farm fingerprint. ua_pattern/org_pattern EXTEND the baked-in defaults (Postgres regex, case-insensitive). fp_fanout = how many distinct cookies AND distinct IPs one device fingerprint must span before it is treated as a residential-proxy scraper farm (default 12; set below 2 to disable) — real visitors are wide on at most one of those axes, never both.
_keys.geo_overrides: DISPLAY RELABEL — force the shown city/region/country for any IP starting with ip_prefix (fixes IPs geolocated to the wrong place, e.g. an HK VPN read as Frankfurt).
